venueHeatmap.title: Venue slot strength
venueHeatmap.description: How busy each weekday and meal period is for this location, based on order count (unique bills), compared to the average slot.
venueHeatmap.unitsLabel: Demand index — each cell shows orders in that slot vs the average (1.0× = average)
venueHeatmap.sortHint: Click a column header to sort meal periods by day.
venueHeatmap.scrollHint: Swipe sideways to see all days →
venueHeatmap.explainTitle: How venue slot strength is calculated
venueHeatmap.explainBody: The grid has 35 slots (7 weekdays × 5 meal periods). Each order is counted once by bill number and placed in the slot of its order time. The demand index is that slot's share of all orders divided by the average slot share (1/35). 1.0× is average traffic; below 1.0 is quieter; above 1.0 is busier. Darker cells mean more orders relative to other slots. This uses order count only — not revenue or item quantity.

timing.pairSelectorAriaLabel: Select combo pair for timing analysis
timing.noPeakData: No co-orders recorded for this pair in the report period.
timing.peakExplanationIntro: The peak line above combines two views: the strongest day and meal period for this pair, and the single hour with the most co-orders across the whole report. They can differ — for example, Wed · Lunch may stand out relative to lunch traffic while 18:00 has the highest total volume when all days are added together.
timing.peakExplanationDayMeal: Shows how often this pair appears in each day and meal period compared with overall traffic in that slot. Values above 1× mean the pair shows up more often than average. Darker cells highlight where the pair over-indexes.
timing.peakExplanationHourly: Shows the raw number of checks that included both items in each hour, summed across every day in the report. The busiest hour here is not limited to the peak day or meal period above.
